messages:
anya: Heads-up — our Q4 forecast shows two concentrated burst windows next quarter (marketing holiday push + large customer onboarding). We need to agree tradeoffs: immediate buys, short leases, or regional cloud-bursting. Inputs: GPU-hour projections, APAC constraints, and cost signals.

mike: Can you paste the rough numbers so we can sanity-check capacity math?

anya: Quick sketch:
```
baseline_gpu_hours_per_month = 1_800_000
peak_multiplier = 1.35  # predicted traffic spikes
peak_gpu_hours = baseline_gpu_hours_per_month * peak_multiplier  # ~2_430_000
safety_headroom = 1.20
required_gpu_hours = peak_gpu_hours * safety_headroom  # ~2_916_000/month
hours_per_gpu_month = 24 * 30  # 720
approx_required_gpus = required_gpu_hours / hours_per_gpu_month  # ~4044 GPUs
```
These are back-of-envelope — need more granular per-model breakdowns (chat vs embed vs rerank).

leo: ~4k concurrent GPUs is a big capital ask. Leasing or hybrid buys make more sense. Note: APAC / edge regions currently have limited procurement options — partner bursts there cost a 1.8x premium right now.

sophia: Observability note — APAC 95th latency degrades around 70% of baseline on current fleet, so we risk SLO violations if we naively route more traffic. Two tactical mitigations: 1) quantized smaller model variants for APAC, 2) aggressive prefix caching for common prompts. Both reduce GPU-hours/latency tradeoff.

jordan: High-level cost sketch (very rough):
- CapEx buy: GPU hardware ~$10k/GPU => 4k -> $40M + rack/network/ops.
- Lease: 12mo reservation + burst capacity looks smaller upfront but higher unit cost (est 1.2–1.6x/year vs buy amortized over 3yrs).
Need finance to run NPV and cashflow impacts.

ops-bot: autoscaler snapshot: current_pool=2800_gpus, avg_util=62%, p95_util_tail=15%. Recent surge event (last month) lasted ~36 hours with 28% overspill handled by ROAM partner.

mike: Suggestion for proposal we can present to leadership:
- Short term (next 3 months): procure a 6-month burst lease to cover two peak months (cheaper than immediate buy, preserves flexibility). Simultaneously deploy APAC quantized fallback and cache TTL reductions to shave ~10–18% GPU-hours.
- Mid term (6–18 months): staged buy of reserved capacity targeted to US + EU core workloads, financed across FY budgets.
- Long term (18–36 months): evaluate on-prem / colo buys if price signals persist and utilization >70% sustained.

leo: +1 to staged buys. Also request: show sensitivity matrix for 3 scenarios (optimistic/no surge, expected surge, high surge 50%+). Need model-level breakdown. I can run simulations if you give me per-route token mix.

sophia: I'll prototype APAC quantized small-chat model this week and share perf delta. Early estimate: 20–30% lower token throughput per GPU but 40–60% lower memory -> more efficient packing.

jordan: I'll ping finance for a quick NPV on buy vs 12mo lease vs hybrid. Can we get list of target months for the expected marketing windows? Finance wants precise months to align cash flows.

anya: Marketing windows are mid-August (launch) and late-November (holiday). Action items:
- mike: run procurement TCO and prepared slides for exec (due Wed)
- sophia: APAC quantized prototype (POC by Fri)
- leo: sensitivity sims per-route (start today)
- jordan: finance NPV and lease quotes (by next Tue)

mike: Ack, I'll start with per-model GPU-hour split and include COGS estimates.

sophia: Ack :pray: will post perf logs in #eng-ml when ready.

leo: Ack. I'll also reach out to two regional partners for burst pricing and SLA details.

deploy-bot: FYI — deploy window for cache TTL change scheduled tonight 02:00 UTC. If anything blocks, post here.

anya: Great — let's reconvene after the POC data and the finance numbers. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
